verdict.rationale: Mistral's own marketing says OCR 4 can be deployed on a single container that keeps document data in your environment, and positions Document AI for secure on-premises deployment. That is a first-party self-hosting claim for this product. However, the pack has no deployment documentation, VPC guidance, licensing terms or hands-on confirmation, so how far the claim extends is unproven. Missing for 10: technical self-hosting/VPC deployment docs, confirmation that the full extraction stack (annotations, QnA) runs self-hosted rather than just the OCR model, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can run the extraction stack in my own VPC or fully self-hosted when documents can't leave my infrastructure
